newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil police hunt man who tried to poison 2,000.
newsitem.headline: Brazil police hunt man who tried to poison 2,000.

text.p: Police were hunting on Thursday for a man suspected of trying to poison 2,000 people at an election rally.

"It looks like it was a political rival who paid someone to poison the food," said detective Andre Luiz Bastos in the city of Capelinha, Minas Gerais state, near the town of Angelandia where the rally took place last Sunday.

Bastos said a 17-year-old youth confessed to police he had been paid the equivalent of $50 by an unidentified man to pour a white powder into a huge helping of roast manioc flour that was served up at the rally.
Nearly 2,000 people suffering from diarrhoea and vomiting were broughts to hospitals in three nearby towns and many remained under care, the police officer said.
